script: Honey discovered in ancient Egyptian tombs is still perfectly edible today. That's right, this golden sweetness literally never spoils! Imagine a food lasting thousands of years. And get this: the shortest war ever recorded lasted only 38 minutes, between Britain and Zanzibar. Talk about a quick conflict! Ever heard of square poop? Wombats actually produce cube-shaped droppings. It helps them mark territory without rolling away. But here's a truly mind-bending thought: there are more stars in the universe than grains of sand on all the beaches on Earth. Mind-blowing, right? These are just some of the incredible facts, like how honey discovered in ancient Egyptian tombs is still perfectly edible today.
